details: Ethereum's Platåberget upgrade (Glamsterdam) is entering public testing, but the subsequent major network upgrade has been postponed to late 2026. This delay is prompting developers to accelerate efforts to finalize proposals for the 2027 Hegotá fork, potentially impacting the overall development roadmap.
title: Ethereum's Major Upgrade Delayed to Late 2026, Sparks Roadmap Scramble

details: Cboe is seeking a special SEC exemption to launch 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). This initiative follows substantial losses, up to 96%, experienced by 2x leveraged crypto funds, indicating a move towards higher-risk investment products in the crypto derivatives market.
title: Cboe Pushes for 3x Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs After 2x Funds See Heavy Losses

details: Bitcoin remains capped under $64,000, with its total market capitalization hovering around $2.17 trillion. The market is facing pressure from the expiration of the 60-day U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreement and consistent outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs, which recorded nearly $390 million in the past week.
title: Bitcoin Stalls Below $64K as ETF Outflows and Geopolitical Tensions Weigh

details: Ethereum has seen a rebound, climbing back above the $1,900 mark, with technical analysts suggesting a sustained move past $1,960 could confirm stronger bullish momentum. However, the crypto asset continues to navigate regulatory uncertainties and somewhat cautious capital flows.
title: Ethereum Reclaims $1,900; Analysts Target $1,960 Breakout Amidst Mixed Signals

details: Reuters reports that cryptocurrency exchange Binance provided Russian authorities with personal and transaction data of a user. This information was subsequently used as evidence in a terrorism financing case against a Russian IT specialist who had made crypto donations to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns.
title: Binance Shared User Data with Russian Authorities for Ukraine Donation Case

details: Matt Hougan, Chief Investment Officer at Bitwise, has reiterated his prediction that Bitcoin will reach $200,000 by 2026. This forecast is supported by observed whale accumulation patterns during recent market pullbacks, suggesting a strategic positioning by large investors.
title: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan Predicts Bitcoin to Reach $200,000 by 2026

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced its total Ethereum (ETH) holdings have grown to 5.82 million tokens, valued at approximately $11.4 billion. The company has also staked over 5 million ETH, anticipating annualized staking rewards of $250 million, indicating significant institutional investment in Ethereum's ecosystem.
title: Bitmine Immersion Technologies' Ethereum Holdings Swell to $11.4 Billion

details: SafePal, a cryptocurrency wallet provider, has disclosed a data breach that resulted in unauthorized access to the order information of approximately 39,798 customers. The exposed data includes personal details such as names, addresses, and purchase histories, stemming from an authorization flaw in their order tracking system.
title: Crypto Wallet Provider SafePal Discloses Data Breach Affecting 40,000 Users
